We're picking an on-call scheduling tool for our engineering team of 40 people, and we need single sign-on. Please read the pricing pages for Rotamere, Wakespan and Vigilark:

https://rotamere.example/pricing
https://wakespan.example/pricing
https://vigilark.example/pricing

Write notes/pricing.md with each vendor's plans, the price per seat per month on yearly billing (and on monthly billing where they show it), any seat minimums, and which plan includes single sign-on and what it costs. Then work out what 40 seats with single sign-on would cost for a year on yearly billing at each vendor, and recommend the cheapest. Stick to what the pages say.

Vigilark How it works Pricing
Pricing
Two plans, no surprises. Pay for the people who take shifts, and invite everyone else for free.
Plan | Annual plan | Monthly plan | Seats
Basic | $11 per seat per month | $14 per seat per month | Any number
Pro | $24 per seat per month | $30 per seat per month | 8 seats or more
What's in each plan
Basic covers schedules, rotations, escalations and alerts by phone, text and push.
Pro adds follow-the-sun rotations, postmortem templates, an audit trail and priority support.
Add-ons
Single sign-on (SAML) is available on Pro as an add-on for $4 per seat per month, billed the same way as the plan.
Extra phone alerts in regions outside North America and Europe are billed at cost.
Questions
Agents in your support team can see who is on call without a paid seat.
You can switch between annual and monthly billing at renewal.
Prices in US dollars. Taxes may apply.

args.content:
# On-call scheduling pricing comparison

Prices below are per paid seat per month in USD, based on each vendor's pricing page. Annual prices are the stated monthly rate with yearly billing; the annual totals below multiply that rate by 12 months and 40 seats. Taxes and any unlisted discounts are not included.

## Plans and SSO

### Rotamere

- **Free:** $0; up to 5 users.
- **Team:** $19/seat/month billed yearly, or $23/seat/month billed monthly.
- **Business:** $36/seat/month billed yearly, or $43/seat/month billed monthly; minimum 10 users. Includes SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning.
- **Enterprise:** Contact sales; includes everything in Business.
- **SSO:** Included in Business, so 40 seats can use the $36 annual-billing rate. The page does not state a separate SSO price.

### Wakespan

- **Starter:** $16/seat/month billed annually, or $20/seat/month month to month.
- **Professional:** $29/seat/month billed annually, or $35/seat/month month to month.
- **Enterprise:** $47/seat/month, billed annually only; 25-user minimum. Includes SSO (SAML and OIDC).
- **SSO:** Included in Enterprise at $47/seat/month on annual billing. No monthly-billing price is shown for Enterprise.

### Vigilark

- **Basic:** $11/seat/month on an annual plan, or $14/seat/month on a monthly plan; any number of seats.
- **Pro:** $24/seat/month on an annual plan, or $30/seat/month on a monthly plan; minimum 8 seats.
- **SSO:** SAML is a Pro add-on for $4/seat/month, billed the same way as the plan. Pro with SSO therefore costs $28/seat/month on annual billing ($24 + $4), or $34/seat/month on monthly billing ($30 + $4).

## Cost for 40 seats with SSO, yearly billing

| Vendor | SSO plan and annual-billing rate | Calculation | Cost for one year |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Rotamere | Business, $36/seat/month | 40 × $36 × 12 | **$17,280** |
| Wakespan | Enterprise, $47/seat/month | 40 × $47 × 12 | **$22,560** |
| Vigilark | Pro + SSO, $28/seat/month | 40 × ($24 + $4) × 12 | **$13,440** |

**Recommendation:** Vigilark is cheapest for 40 seats with SSO on yearly billing, at **$13,440 per year**, based on the listed plan and add-on prices.
